scope: Development diagnosis on archived captures; associations only, not identified causes.

definitions.requests: admitted and successful trace requests; miss = TTFT > 0.5 s
definitions.recent_tokens: prompt tokens of other admitted requests accepted in the preceding 1.0 s
definitions.busy_interval: scrape interval with num_requests_running >= 4 at its end
definitions.tok_accepted: prompt tokens of requests accepted (gateway) in the interval
definitions.sq_accepted: sum of squared prompt tokens of requests accepted in the interval (posted proxy)
definitions.tok_first: prompt tokens of requests whose gateway first content arrived in the interval
definitions.tok_spread: prompt tokens spread uniformly over each request's [accept, first content) span
definitions.sq_spread: squared prompt tokens spread the same way
definitions.step_models: interval wall time ~ no-intercept least squares on the listed terms
definitions.posted_intervals: failed scrapes dropped before differencing (as in the #30 comment)
definitions.strict_intervals: no bridging of failed scrapes; 0.8-1.3 s; counter continuity
